issues.title: Create a dated backup branch of the current main
issues.body:
## Scope

Create a branch named `backup/main-2026-10-19` from the current tip of `main` (commit `07e909f`, the merge of pull request #94) and push it to origin.
The branch is a read-only snapshot: no commits go on it, and the existing `v1.0` tag and `backup/v1.0` branch stay as they are. Check that the pushed branch points to the same commit as `main` did when it was created.
If a branch already exists on origin that points to the current `main` tip, skip creating it and record that existing branch as the restore point instead.
Add a short entry to the existing rollback/versioning doc listing this branch as a restore point, described as the state after the texture/hair/tongue removal and the pose fixes. Restoring from it follows the existing method in that doc: make a branch from the backup and open a pull request into `main`.

## Files

Repository branches, rollback/versioning doc under `docs/`

issues.title: Generate the soft-tissue simulation proxy from the face mesh
issues.body:
## Scope

Add a build-time script that reads the neutral face mesh (default FaceCap) and produces a compact binary simulation asset committed to the static assets directory.
The script:
- simplifies the face surface to a coarse proxy, targeting a low thousands-range tetrahedron count with the target count configurable;
- creates an inner surface by offsetting the proxy inward along its normals by a configurable tissue thickness;
- splits each layer cell between the outer and inner surfaces into tetrahedra.
It labels inner-surface nodes as skull-attached or jaw-attached. Jaw-attached means below a configurable mouth-line boundary on the lower face. Outer nodes are labelled as skin.
It computes the render embedding: for every render-mesh vertex, the tetrahedron containing it, or the nearest one, and its barycentric weights.
The asset stores node positions, tetrahedra, edges, node labels, the embedding, and the render vertex count and a hash of the source mesh, so a mismatched face mesh is detected at load time. The script fails if it produces inverted or near-zero-volume tetrahedra or render vertices without an embedding.

## Files

New script under `scripts/`, new simulation asset in the static assets directory

issues.title: Implement the XPBD solver core
Run the solver in a Web Worker with a main-thread fallback
issues.body:
## Scope

Host the solver in a dedicated Web Worker running a fixed-timestep loop. Each frame the main thread sends pose targets and the jaw transform, and the worker returns node positions as transferable typed arrays. Do not rely on SharedArrayBuffer, because the static self-hosted deploy doesn't send the cross-origin isolation headers it needs.
Load the simulation asset once and validate its source-mesh hash and render vertex count against the loaded face mesh, reporting a mismatch as a diagnostic. If workers are unavailable, fall back to running the solver on the main thread at a reduced substep count. The worker must shut down cleanly when physics is turned off or the viewport unmounts.

## Files

New worker module and host bridge under `src/domain/physics/`, `vite.config.ts` if worker bundling needs it

## Dependencies

Depends on: XPBD solver core, simulation proxy asset

issues.title: Map blendshape poses to physics targets
issues.body:
## Scope

Turn the existing pose state into solver inputs without changing the controls. Each frame, evaluate the blendshape-posed surface exactly as the kinematic provider does today. Map it through the embedding to target positions for the proxy's skin nodes. Derive a rigid jaw rotation from the jaw-open weight for the jaw-attached nodes. Keep skull-attached nodes fixed.
This applies to every preset, keyboard and slider pose. Neutral, Smile, and the AA phoneme (jaw open) are the reference poses for tuning and acceptance.

## Files

New pose-target mapper under `src/domain/physics/`, `src/domain/poses/` read-only

## Dependencies

Depends on: Physics worker host
